items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Oh, another cat who used to be in that band I liked, too -- Norman Murphy.

ctx.x: very good. He used to play... I have a... What did he used to play of mine? Oh, this arrangement they had on "Blues In The Night." He could really play the hell out of that.
Oh, another cat who used to be in that band I liked, too -- Norman Murphy. I just got a call from... You know, Norman had a heart attack, too.
